mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Vilis, Broker of Blood
# 1. "{B}, Pay 2 life: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn."  `parse "{B}: Target creature
#    gets -1/-1 until end of turn."` (B13-activated+B5b-modpt-minus) plus the life cost part
#    CostLife (Tavern Swindler's "{T}, Pay 3 life").
# 2. "Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards."  LifeLostEvent (the LifeGainedEvent twin) with
#    the event's amount, as Light of Promise's "Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1
#    counters" reads it: QProp(referent='event', field=AMOUNT).
drain = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)),
            CostLife(amount=QConst(value=2)),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
    }),
)
draw_that_many = TriggeredAbility(
    event=LifeLostEvent(actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {
        'amount': QProp(referent='event', field=QPropField.AMOUNT),
        'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
    }),
)
abilities = [drain, draw_that_many, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {B}, Pay 2 life: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards.
